subject: 3x Boost Chain Work Around
author: Abernyte
body:
There are two ways around this:

Method 1

a.)Backup your save file to a USB stick

b.)Delete the save file on the PS3

c.)Get the 3x boost chain

d.)Once the trophy is rewarded restore your save from the USB stick

Method 2

Get a boost chain at least 3 greater than your current record.

I and several others have successfully used method 1. I haven't tried method 2 but have been told it works.

subject: Logic ?
author: hn6
body: You don't think it's logical to include the achievements with the PDLC? I wouldn't even consider it cynical to expect them to include the achievements only with the PDLC, if only to milk some cash from the achievement junkies.

subject: PDLC Achievo's
author: ZombieTron
body:
I really don't think CG has put much thought or effort into how they can best use their 250 g from releasing PDLC.

I think the Party Pack achievements were not thought through, why not have them the same as the PS3 Trophies? More achievements for less gamerscore is definitely better.

Same with the cars, having small gamerscore achievements is much better then having none at all.

The way the achievements have been so far makes me feel that the remaining 200 gs will probably be in 1 big achievement for finding all the Island collectables or something.

I really hope the Xbox Achievements are given a bit more thought and made in line with the PS3 Trophies.

I like Achievements, not for the gamerscore, but because they can be a way of adding new challenges to a game. I even like the 0 gs achievements! Why not add more of those?? 🙂

subject: At the moment it seems to be
author: Cube
body: At the moment it seems to be just exclusive things that can go over 250 extra achievement points (Halo 3, Fallout 3). Still, I don't see why Criterion couldn't have added 10 achievements for 5G each for the cars.

subject: Achieveables

body: Well, there were two new achievements with the party pack, leaving 200 points left. I honestly thought they were going to add one for finishing the Bike Pack/getting 102%. I would think that they'd do stuff like all billboards and all the new challenges stuff when the island comes out, but clearly they're not thinking logically with these things.
